name: Flirt Lash Lounge & Day Spa
tagline: Let us pamper you. You deserve it.
description: Oceanside California's luxury beauty retreat. A collaboration of North County's most talented independent beauty professionals - eyelash extensions, lash lifts, brow lamination, permanent makeup, skincare, waxing, and nails.
hoursNote: Hours vary depending on artist availability. Live openings are always on the booking calendar.

hero.subhead: Let us pamper you. You deserve it. Lashes, brows, skin, and nails by North County's most talented independent artists.
hero.bgImageAlt: A Flirt lash artist applying individual eyelash extensions to a reclining guest.

body: Our team is a collaboration of North County's most talented independent beauty professionals, specializing in a variety of services tailored to perfection. Each artist offers their own unique customized experience.

Our belief is that everyone should treat themselves to a little me time in order to have a healthy balance of mental and physical wellbeing. What better way to treat yourself than to come melt away in one of our luxury recliners. Trust us, you won't want to leave.
intro.imageAlt: Three Flirt artists in branded aprons in front of the gold Flirt wall in the lounge.

services.headlineLine1: Guests come for the service and
services.intro: Lashes are how most people find us. The full menu is what keeps them coming back - brows, skin, waxing, nails, and permanent makeup, all under one roof.

about.role: Founder · Lash Artist · Educator · Beauty Business Coach
body: Hello! I'm Brooklyn, the Owner of Flirt, Beauty Business Coach, Lash Artist & Educator. I've been doing lashes exclusively for over 13 years, both in California and Melbourne Australia.
I opened Flirt Lash Lounge & Day Spa in October of 2019. It was an amazing feeling to see my dream finally come to life. I'm so proud of our gorgeous space and my amazingly talented team.
We thank you for your business and appreciate it more than you know. Next time you're in, be sure to say hi!
